beijing.headline_zh: 北京，不只是第一站，而是理解中国的序章。
beijing.headline_en: Beijing is not merely a first stop. It is the prologue to understanding China.
beijing.lead_zh: 把紫禁城、胡同、长城与当代北京放进一条有呼吸的私人路线，由真人顾问处理预约、时间与城市尺度。
beijing.lead_en: A private, human-led journey connecting the Forbidden City, hutong life, the Great Wall and contemporary Beijing—with time and reservations handled coherently.
beijing.role_zh: 历史与国家叙事的入口
beijing.role_en: The historical and civic opening chapter
overview_zh: 第一次来北京，最常见的错误是把每个著名地点都塞进同一天。紫禁城需要时间，长城需要一整段天气窗口，胡同与当代艺术也不该只剩车窗里的剪影。
我们通常把核心古迹、城市生活与一天城外行程分开，让旅人真正感受到北京的尺度。酒店位置、预约时段、步行距离和同行者体力会共同决定路线，而不是一张通用清单。
overview_en: The usual mistake on a first Beijing visit is to compress every famous name into the same day. The Forbidden City needs time; the Great Wall deserves a proper weather window; hutong life and contemporary art should not become glimpses through a car window.

We normally separate monumental Beijing, lived-in Beijing and one full day beyond the centre. Hotel location, timed admissions, walking tolerance and the people travelling with you shape the route—not a universal checklist.

moments_zh.title: 宫城与中轴
moments_zh.text: 清晨进入紫禁城，把景山或天坛放在不同半日，避免把空间压缩成赶场。

moments_zh.title: 城墙之外
moments_zh.text: 为长城留出完整一天，并按季节、体力与人流选择段落，而非默认同一个入口。

moments_zh.title: 有人生活的北京
moments_zh.text: 胡同、餐桌、工作室与当代建筑，让历史之外的北京也有具体的人和声音。

moments_en.title: Palaces and the central axis
moments_en.text: Enter the Forbidden City early, then give Jingshan or the Temple of Heaven a separate half-day so scale is not lost to rushing.

moments_en.title: Beyond the city walls
moments_en.text: Keep a full day for the Great Wall and choose the section around season, fitness and crowd tolerance rather than habit.

moments_en.title: The Beijing people live in
moments_en.text: Hutong lanes, dining rooms, studios and contemporary architecture bring people and present-day texture into the historical frame.

faq_zh.q: 北京第一次去住几晚合适？
faq_zh.a: 通常建议 4–5 晚。这样能分开紫禁城、长城与城市生活，也给抵达后的时差和体力留出余量。

faq_zh.q: 北京适合和哪些城市连线？
faq_zh.a: 西安适合延续历史主题；上海形成传统与现代的强对比；成都则把路线带向美食与中国西南。
会。顾问会按最终路线提示并协调需要实名或定时预约的部分，但具体名额与开放状态以相关场馆确认为准。

faq_en.q: How many nights should a first Beijing visit have?
faq_en.a: Usually four to five. That allows the Forbidden City, Great Wall and everyday Beijing to breathe, with some margin for jet lag and walking.

faq_en.q: Which cities pair well with Beijing?
faq_en.a: Xi’an extends the historical thread; Shanghai creates a strong old-and-new contrast; Chengdu opens the route toward food culture and Southwest China.
Yes. Your advisor flags and coordinates timed or real-name bookings around the final route. Availability and opening arrangements remain subject to the relevant venue.

xian.photo_credit: Banja-Frans Mulder / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0
xian.headline_zh: 西安，把漫长历史变成可以行走的城市。
xian.headline_en: Xi’an turns a long history into a city you can still walk through.
xian.lead_zh: 从兵马俑到城墙与坊巷，把宏大历史、地方饮食和当代城市节奏放在同一段私人旅程里。
xian.lead_en: From the Terracotta Army to city walls and neighbourhood tables, connect monumental history, local food and the pace of the present city.
xian.role_zh: 中国古代文明的实体章节
xian.role_en: The tangible chapter of ancient China
overview_zh: 西安不应只有兵马俑的一次往返。它曾是多个王朝的都城，也是丝绸之路东方起点；城墙之内外、博物馆、寺院与夜晚的饮食共同构成城市。
三至四晚能把城外考古与城内生活分开。我们会根据你对历史的兴趣深度、儿童同行、步行体力与饮食偏好选择讲解方式，而不是让一天被展柜和车程填满。
overview_en: Xi’an should not be reduced to a return drive to the Terracotta Army. It was the capital of successive dynasties and an eastern point of the Silk Road; walls, museums, religious sites and evening food culture all belong to the city’s story.

Three to four nights let archaeology beyond the centre and daily life within it remain distinct. We adjust guiding depth around your interest in history, children, walking tolerance and food—not fill a day with display cases and transfers.

moments_zh.title: 兵马俑，不赶场
moments_zh.text: 以好的讲解和充分时间理解遗址，而不是在三个坑之间机械移动。

moments_zh.title: 城墙与城市尺度
moments_zh.text: 步行或骑行一段城墙，再进入街巷，感受古都格局与今日生活的叠加。

moments_zh.title: 丝路留下的餐桌
moments_zh.text: 从面食到清真饮食，以更安静、更有判断的方式进入西安的味觉，而非只追逐夜市人潮。

moments_en.title: The Terracotta Army, unhurried
moments_en.text: Use a strong guide and enough time to understand the site instead of moving mechanically between pits.

moments_en.title: Walls and urban scale
moments_en.text: Walk or cycle one considered section, then enter the streets below to see the ancient plan layered with present life.

moments_en.title: A Silk Road table
moments_en.text: Noodles and Muslim culinary traditions open the city through taste—without reducing the experience to the busiest night-market lane.

faq_zh.a: 第一次到访建议 3–4 晚。两晚容易让兵马俑、博物馆、城墙和城市饮食全部变成赶场。

faq_zh.q: 西安可以从北京坐高铁到吗？
faq_zh.a: 可以，铁路是两城之间常用的连接方式。具体车次、时刻与护照购票要求应在出发前通过铁路 12306 核对。
适合，但要控制博物馆密度并安排互动式讲解。顾问会根据儿童年龄调整步行、用餐与休息节奏。

faq_en.q: How many nights does Xi’an need?
faq_en.a: Three to four nights is a sound first stay. With only two, the Terracotta Army, museums, walls and food culture tend to become a race.

faq_en.q: Can I take a high-speed train from Beijing to Xi’an?
faq_en.a: Yes, rail is a common connection between the two cities. Check current services, times and passport ticketing requirements through China Railway 12306 before travel.
Yes, provided museum density is controlled and guiding is engaging. Your advisor adjusts walking, meals and rest around the children’s ages.

shanghai.photo_credit: Ernest Jourdier / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0
shanghai.headline_zh: 上海，是中国之旅最清晰的当代对照。
shanghai.headline_en: Shanghai is the clearest contemporary counterpoint in a China journey.
shanghai.lead_zh: 外滩、里弄、当代艺术与江南腹地，在一座适合步行、进餐与慢慢观察的门户城市里交汇。
shanghai.lead_en: The Bund, lane-house neighbourhoods, contemporary art and the lower Yangtze meet in a gateway city made for walking, dining and close observation.
shanghai.role_zh: 现代中国与江南的门户
shanghai.role_en: Gateway to modern China and Jiangnan
overview_zh: 上海的价值不是多看几个高楼，而是理解这座城市如何在不同年代之间切换。外滩与浦东只是一条视觉轴线，真正的城市体验藏在街区尺度、建筑细节、餐桌和文化空间里。
三至四晚适合作为入境后的柔和起步或离境前的收束。我们会按酒店位置安排步行半径，把热门地标与更安静的街区、展览或江南一日组合起来。
overview_en: Shanghai’s value is not the number of towers seen, but the way the city changes register between eras. The Bund and Pudong form one visual axis; the lived experience sits in neighbourhood scale, architectural detail, dining rooms and cultural spaces.

Three to four nights work as a gentle arrival or an elegant final chapter. We plan walking radii around the hotel, then balance recognisable landmarks with quieter streets, an exhibition or a considered day into Jiangnan.

moments_zh.title: 一条河，两种城市想象
moments_zh.text: 在外滩与浦东之间理解上海的时间层次，不把天际线只当作拍照背景。

moments_zh.title: 以街区为单位行走
moments_zh.text: 法租界旧址、里弄与当代生活需要慢步，好的路线应围绕建筑、咖啡、店铺与人的节奏。

moments_zh.title: 把江南放进延伸线
moments_zh.text: 杭州、苏州或水乡可成为一日或下一站，但选择取决于季节、周末人流和你真正想看的内容。

moments_en.title: One river, two urban imaginations
moments_en.text: Read Shanghai’s layers between the Bund and Pudong rather than treating the skyline as a photograph alone.

moments_en.title: Walk by neighbourhood, not landmark
moments_en.text: Former French Concession streets and lane houses reward a route shaped around architecture, cafés, shops and human pace.

moments_en.title: Let Jiangnan extend the story
moments_en.text: Hangzhou, Suzhou or a water town can become a day or the next stop, chosen around season, weekend crowds and what you actually want to see.

faq_zh.a: 建议 3–4 晚。既能完成城市内部的历史与当代对照，也能选择是否加入江南一日。

faq_zh.q: 上海适合旅程开始还是结束？
faq_zh.a: 都适合。国际航班选择多、城市服务成熟；开始时可缓冲时差，结束时适合购物、进餐与从容离境。

faq_zh.q: 苏州、杭州和水乡应该都去吗？
faq_zh.a: 通常不建议一次全部加入。顾问会按季节、兴趣、周末人流与下一段路线选择一个最合适的延伸。

faq_en.q: How many nights should a first Shanghai visit have?
faq_en.a: Three to four nights. That gives the historical and contemporary city enough space, with the option of one Jiangnan day.

faq_en.q: Is Shanghai better at the start or end of a China trip?
faq_en.a: Either works. Strong international connections and mature city services make it useful for easing into jet lag or finishing with dining, shopping and a calm departure.

faq_en.q: Should I visit Suzhou, Hangzhou and a water town?
faq_en.a: Usually not all in one short stay. Your advisor chooses the most relevant extension around season, interests, weekend crowds and the next stage of the route.

chongqing.photo_credit: Junyi Lou / Wikimedia Commons · CC BY-SA 4.0
chongqing.headline_zh: 重庆，沿着江流与山色，找到自己的节奏。
chongqing.headline_en: Chongqing. City lights, river gorges, mountain quiet.
chongqing.lead_zh: 用八天七晚，选择一段真正适合你的山城旅程：城市与金佛山的从容、三晚三峡游轮的度假，或把江与山连起来的全景深游。
chongqing.lead_en: Three ways to shape eight days and seven nights: city life with a mountain retreat, three nights cruising the Yangtze, or a fuller journey bringing river and mountain together.
chongqing.role_zh: 城市烟火与长江山水的交汇
chongqing.role_en: City life meets the Yangtze landscape
chongqing.pair_zh: 金佛山、长江三峡与宜昌
overview_zh: 重庆的立体街巷值得按区域慢走：渝中的步道与江边、沙坪坝的老街、鹅岭的城市视角，不必挤在同一天。夜景只留给合适的晚上，白天也能有一顿长午餐与酒店休息。
三条参考线路都从重庆开始、回重庆结束。A 留出城市与山居的余量；B 用三晚游轮换来连住的安定；C 把三峡与金佛山连在一起，需要接受更长交通。先选节奏，再决定酒店、船只与出发日期。
overview_en: Read Chongqing district by district: the lanes and waterfront of Yuzhong, the old streets of Shapingba and the city views from Eling deserve separate moments. Save night views for the right evenings, with time for a long lunch and a hotel pause.

All three samples start and finish in Chongqing. A leaves room for city and mountain stays; B settles into three consecutive cruise nights; C combines gorges and Jinfo with longer connections. Choose the rhythm first, then the hotels, ship and travel dates.

moments_zh.title: 山城的日常
moments_zh.text: 步道、江边、火锅与老街，按区域安排，也按同行者的体力取舍。

moments_zh.title: 江上的三晚
moments_zh.text: B与C参考四天三晚下水游轮，用同一间舱房连接不同江岸风景。

moments_zh.title: 山林与温泉
moments_zh.text: A与C加入金佛山，按天气和开放选择步道，把晚上留给休息与可选温泉。

moments_en.title: A city lived in
moments_en.text: Lanes, waterfronts, hotpot and old streets, grouped by district and shaped around walking tolerance.

moments_en.title: Three river nights
moments_en.text: B and C reference a four-day downstream sailing, with one cabin connecting changing river landscapes.

moments_en.title: Mountain time
moments_en.text: A and C include Jinfo, choosing paths around weather and access, with evenings for rest or optional hot springs.

faq_zh.a: 不想坐船、希望弹性较多，先看A；第一次看三峡并喜欢船上度假，选B；体力好、希望同时看三峡和金佛山，可考虑C，但要接受D6长转场。
通常先讨论A或B，同时确认步行能力、台阶和上下船条件。A的山路与景区也需要取舍；C不作为老人或幼儿家庭的首选。

faq_zh.q: 游轮景点、船名和价格确定了吗？
faq_zh.a: 目前展示的是参考结构。顾问会按日期确认航次、码头、是否需要中转、船只和舱型，并逐项说明餐食、上岸游览及自费项目，随后提供定制报价。

faq_zh.q: C线最后一晚为什么有两个住法？
faq_zh.a: D8是晚班机且转场缓冲充足，才考虑D7继续住金佛山；早班、中午或下午较早航班，D7必须回重庆主城住。顾问会在确认前把车站、车次和送机时间串起来。

faq_zh.q: 可以保证云海、日出或所有栈道吗？
faq_zh.a: 不能。金佛山和三峡观景受天气影响，山上步道、索道与温泉以实际营业及开放通知为准，行程会保留替代和休息安排。

faq_en.a: Start with A for a cruise-free trip with more flexibility, or B for a first Three Gorges cruise. C combines the gorges and Jinfo for fit travellers who accept a long D6 connection.

faq_en.q: Does this work for children or older travellers?
faq_en.a: We generally discuss A or B first, then check steps, walking tolerance and embarkation access. A still needs tailoring on the mountain. C is not our first choice for older travellers or families with young children.

faq_en.q: Are the ship, stops and price fixed?
faq_en.a: These are sample structures. Your advisor confirms the sailing, pier, possible coach connection, ship and cabin for your dates, then explains meals, shore visits and optional charges in a tailored quotation.

faq_en.q: Why does C have two options for the final night?
faq_en.a: A second Jinfo night is considered only with a late D8 flight and adequate connection margin. For morning, midday or early-afternoon flights, D7 must end at a Chongqing hotel. Rail, road and airport timings are checked before confirmation.

faq_en.q: Are sunrise, clouds or all mountain paths guaranteed?
faq_en.a: No. Weather affects Jinfo and the gorges; paths, cableways and hot springs follow operating notices. The plan keeps alternatives and room to rest.

xishuangbanna.headline_zh:
在云南的南方，
把日子交给雨林。
xishuangbanna.lead_zh: 沿着林间小径、澜沧江与傣乡村落，走进云南的另一种节奏。四晚连住，让出游与度假各有自己的时间。
xishuangbanna.lead_en: Forest paths, the Lancang River and Dai culture reveal another rhythm of Yunnan. Stay four nights in one place, with time for both exploration and retreat.
overview_zh: 西双版纳的好，在于离开一张景点清单。林下听向导辨认植物，江上感受风，再回到有庭院与泳池的住处，让同一片风景慢慢变得熟悉。
以景洪为住宿基地，基诺山、野象谷与勐仑各留出清楚的出游段落。首尾两天留给抵离，中间三天各有主题；不把远处景点塞进接机或送机的间隙。
overview_en: Xishuangbanna rewards attention: a guide identifying plants beneath the canopy, a breeze on the river, then a return to a courtyard and pool. The landscape becomes familiar when you stay a little longer.
Use Jinghong as a base, with distinct excursions to Jinuo Mountain, Wild Elephant Valley and Menglun. Keep arrival and departure days clear and give each of the three middle days its own theme.

moments_zh.title: 走进林下
moments_zh.text: 基诺山轻徒步，以独立向导和植物探索为核心；水上与溪流项目根据当日条件调整。

moments_zh.title: 顺着江风
moments_zh.text: 澜沧江与野象谷串起河流和雨林体验，为天气、体力和活动开放留出弹性。

moments_zh.title: 读懂傣乡
moments_zh.text: 把植物园讲解、傣族园与夜市放在不同的旅程片段里，从自然与日常进入地方文化。

moments_en.title: Beneath the canopy
moments_en.text: A private guide and plant exploration anchor the Jinuo walk. Water and stream activities adapt to conditions.

moments_en.title: Along the river
moments_en.text: The Lancang River and Wild Elephant Valley connect river and rainforest, with room for weather and changing plans.

moments_en.title: A sense of Dai culture
moments_en.text: Botanical interpretation, Dai Garden and an evening market offer different ways into the landscape and local life.

faq_zh.a: 四晚连住景洪，D1接机入住、D5送机，中间三天分别安排基诺山、野象谷与澜沧江、植物园与傣族园。
不含。约人民币8,000元／人为12–16人、两人一房的参考价，含酒店早餐，不含往返大交通及机票和其他餐食；实际以最终报价为准。

faq_zh.q: 研究员带队和水上项目一定能安排吗？
faq_zh.a: 研究员身份和档期需预约确认。竹筏、溯溪、快艇、骑马、牧象及泼水活动按开放情况、天气和参与条件确认，不作为无条件保证。

faq_zh.q: 可以调整为家庭或更小团队吗？
faq_zh.a: 可以重新设计。人数变化会影响车辆、房数、向导安排及人均价格；提供出行月份、人数和步行偏好后，由顾问重新报价。

faq_en.q: How do five days and four nights work?
faq_en.a: Stay four nights in Jinghong. Days 1 and 5 are for transfers; the three middle days cover Jinuo Mountain, Wild Elephant Valley and the Lancang River, then the botanical garden and Dai Garden.

faq_en.q: Are flights included in the reference price?
faq_en.a: No. Approximately CNY 8,000 per person is based on 12–16 guests sharing two to a room. Hotel breakfast is included; flights, intercity travel and other meals are excluded. The final quotation confirms the total.

faq_en.q: Are the researcher and water activities guaranteed?
faq_en.a: The named specialist and date require confirmation. Rafting, stream walks, speedboats, horse riding, managed elephant activities and water-splashing depend on access, conditions and participant suitability.

faq_en.q: Can this be adapted for a family or smaller group?
faq_en.a: Yes. Group size changes the vehicle, rooms, guiding arrangements and per-person cost. Share your month, group size and walking preferences for a revised proposal.
